x-what-this-is: The showcase catalogue's row list (ROADMAP M1.6, ADR-011 section 4), read by LoadCatalogueManifest and cooked by CookCatalogue. One entry per exhibit; an entry with no `variant` is the unpatched base -- the row every patch is a diff against. `solo_binding` and `extra_bindings` record the per-entry binding choices that previously lived only as C++ literals inside tests: meter_loop's super_beam chord, microwalk's single-button build. Entries are cooked in this order and the order is part of the catalogue.
